rundown: Cyclones beat Bearcats 3-2 at Hilton Coliseum in Ames, Iowa.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 16, 7:28 PM ET. It had Bearcats 41% and Cyclones 59%, projecting Bearcats 1.7 – Cyclones 2.1 (3.8 total, Cyclones by 0.4).

Final: Bearcats 2 – Cyclones 3. Right winner: it had Cyclones at 59%.

Thin data: 0 of 6 key inputs were sourced (missing: CIN sets scored, CIN sets allowed, CIN lineup rating or past seasons, ISU sets scored, ISU sets allowed, ISU lineup rating or past seasons), so league averages filled the gaps. It was logged as a no-data call: graded and learned from, never offered as a bet.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bearcats came in with a league-average attack and a 6% leakier than average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 8 and 9 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.7, they scored 2 (+0.3 sets, 18% over); projected to allow 2.1, they allowed 3 (+0.9 sets, 45% over).

Cyclones came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.1, they scored 3 (+0.9 sets, 45% over); projected to allow 1.7, they allowed 2 (+0.3 sets, 18% over).

The bigger miss was Cyclones' scoring (+0.9 sets against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 5 against 3.8 projected (+1.2), about the 94th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±0.8).

Margin: Cyclones by 1 against Cyclones by 0.4 projected, about the 65th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.6).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.242 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +0.8 sets. It counts toward Volleyball scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 481 graded Volleyball games the algo now scales scoring ×0.961 and gives home teams +0.1 sets. Team corrections so far: Bearcats attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
